name: Jeff Helfrich
occupation: Retired Portland police officer; state representative (House District 52)

bio.statement: His official legislative page says Helfrich served as a Portland Police Bureau sergeant for 25 years.
bio.excerpt: and as a sergeant with the Portland Police Bureau for 25 years.

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Helfrich lists his occupation as state representative, with a background as a retired police sergeant, Cascade Locks city councilor, MCEDD board member, U.S. Air Force service and farmhand.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative Occupational Background: Retired Police Sergeant;Cascade Locks City Councilor;MCEDD Board of Directors;US Air Force, Farmhand.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: In a February 2025 Oregon Capital Chronicle report, Helfrich says his work on re-criminalizing drugs and campaign finance reform shows he can pass major legislation.
positions.excerpt: My successes re-criminalizing drugs and passing campaign finance reform prove I can champion major legislation

positions.statement: Helfrich says he helped lead the bipartisan effort to re-criminalize hard drugs.
positions.excerpt: I helped lead the bipartisan effort to re-criminalize hard drugs and restore accountability.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Helfrich says housing, groceries, energy, insurance and taxes come out of the same paycheck and he will keep fighting unnecessary tax increases and wasteful spending.
